definitions: To end a phone conversation abruptly or rudely while the other person is still speaking or expecting to continue.
To terminate a telephone call by replacing the receiver or pressing an 'end call' button, often implying a lack of desire to continue the conversation.
examples: She didn't like what he was saying, so she decided to hang up on him.
I can't believe you would hang up on me!
He threatened to hang up on the telemarketer if they didn't stop calling.
pastTenses: hung up on, hung up on
